title: ForensicAuditReport
description: Master contract for IndSure forensic policy analysis output. Prompt is single source of scoring truth.

assumed_zone.description: A=Metro, B=Tier2, C=Tier3. Never Unknown — default to A if city unclear.

personal_waiting_periods.description: Individually applied waiting periods from policy schedule (e.g. ear disorders, specific conditions).

relevant.description: false if male or age > 45. Skip scoring entirely if false.

claim_simulations.description: Two scenarios: standard hospitalisation + major surgery, both zone-calibrated.

audit_score.description: All scoring computed by prompt. Server does not modify these values.

summary.description: Max 15 words. Plain English. No jargon. No score numbers.

will_this_policy_protect_in_real_claim.description: 2-3 plain sentences. What actually happens in a real claim.

critical_actions.description: Required field. Must be populated if ANY coverage gap exists.

_changelog.3.0: Removed duplicate audit_ledger/audit_score. Removed zone D and Unknown. Added no_claim_bonus. Added personal_waiting_periods. Added claim_simulations as top-level array. Made critical_actions required. Prompt is single source of scoring truth.
